description: This file defines data structures and functions for representing and comparing 'flat' data objects, including differences at various levels such as primitives, sequences, sets, maps, and objects. It includes marker definitions, difference case classes, and utility methods for diffing flat objects.

classes.name: Marker
classes.description: Object containing marker constants and utility methods for identifying marker types in flat objects.

classes.name: FlatDifference
classes.description: Trait representing a difference between flat objects.

classes.name: TerminalFlatDifference
classes.description: Trait for differences that are terminal (no further diffing needed).

classes.name: NoFlatDifference
classes.description: Represents no difference; holds a value.

classes.name: TypeFlatDifference
classes.description: Represents a type mismatch difference between two objects.

classes.name: PrimitiveFlatDifference
classes.description: Represents a difference between primitive flat objects.

classes.name: MissingField
classes.description: Singleton object indicating a missing field difference.

classes.name: ExtraField
classes.description: Singleton object indicating an extra field difference.

classes.name: OrderingFlatDifference
classes.description: Difference in order of sequence elements.

classes.name: IndexedFlatDifference
classes.description: Difference between sequences with indexed elements.

classes.name: MapFlatDifference
classes.description: Difference between maps, including key differences and value differences.

classes.name: ObjectFlatDifference
classes.description: Difference between object-like structures represented as maps.

methods.name: FlatDifference.apply
methods.description: Factory method to create a FlatDifference between two FlatObjects, dispatching to specific diff methods based on object types.
